text:
maria_acme: Hey team — promo code `ACMEDED10` landed on our Hosted org instead of the Dedicated trial we requested. Provision for the dedicated cluster keeps failing with a quota error. Can someone re-route the grant?

Sam - Support: Sorry about that — can you paste the tenant/org id and the promo/grant id shown in the portal? I can look it up and open an internal reassign.

maria_acme: org: `acme-corp-42`, grant id: `G-2026-09-8123`, region: `us-west-2`. It shows SKU `hosted-starter` in the grant details. We need `dedicated-100` trial capacity to test cluster provisioning.

Sam - Support: Thanks. Investigating now. Running internal check...

Sam - Support: ```
# internal grantctl output
grantctl get G-2026-09-8123 --json
{
  "id": "G-2026-09-8123",
  "promo": "ACMEDED10",
  "applied_to": "org:acme-corp-42",
  "sku": "hosted-starter",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "status": "active"
}
```

Sam - Support: Looks like the grant is attached to the hosted SKU. Reassigning to `dedicated-100` needs a billing entitlement change because that SKU consumes reserved capacity. Tagging @Priya - AM to approve escalation.

Priya - AM: @Jorge - Billing this needs a one-time entitlement reassign for ACME. They were approved for a dedicated trial during the sales POC. Can you reassign `G-2026-09-8123` to `dedicated-100` and confirm? I'll attach the approval note.

Jorge - Billing: On it. I need to back up the audit record first and then reassign. Running safe reassign script (takes ~2min).

Jorge - Billing: ```
# billingctl reassign (dry-run)
billingctl reassign --grant G-2026-09-8123 --to-sku dedicated-100 --region us-west-2 --reason "approved POC - Priya"
# dry-run ok
# executing
billingctl reassign --grant G-2026-09-8123 --to-sku dedicated-100 --region us-west-2 --force
```

grant-bot: Audit: grant G-2026-09-8123 reassigned from `hosted-starter` to `dedicated-100` by `jorge_billing` at 2026-06-02T15:03:10Z. (log id: A-98765)

Sam - Support: Reassign complete on our side. I also cleared any cached entitlement for `acme-corp-42`. Maria, can you retry the dedicated provision flow?

maria_acme: Retrying now... provisioning step passed! Dedicated cluster created. Thank you 🙏

Sam - Support: Great — marking resolved. Priya: I'll attach the audit log and close the support ticket. If you want the promo moved back later or split across orgs let us know. :white_check_mark:

Priya - AM: Adding note to account: approved POC dedicated trial applied. Thanks all.

maria_acme: Appreciated — smooth. Cheers.
